reason: The company reported a 130% year-over-year growth in utility-scale project execution, signaling strong operational momentum in its renewable energy segment.
why_now: The official exchange filing was released on October 12, 2026, detailing Q2 FY27 performance.
source_headlines: Tata Power Company Limited: Tata Power Company Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated October 12, 2026, titled "Tata Power Renewables Records over 130% YoY Growth in Utility-Scale Execution in Q2 FY27, delivering 419 MW Capacity along with 131.2 MWhr of Battery Storage Projects".
